title: Data table
description: A table: a header row from a list of column labels, one row per item of the data (a list of cell values), group rows ({ group }), note rows ({ note }) and further header rows ({ header: [labels] }, a stacked block's own) among them, a caption and a note. A cell the data leaves empty prints empty and is listed to complete.

numbered.description: true: "Table 3: …"; false: the caption alone, taking no number; "silent": the caption alone, taking a number.

rows.description: Each a list of cell values, or { group: text }, { note: text } or { header: [labels] }.

padding.description: Cell padding, points: { top, bottom, left, right }.

line.description: Line height of the table's text: a multiple, or { "exact": 12 } or { "atLeast": 12 } in points.

repeatHeader.description: false: the header row is not repeated at the top of each page.

autoFit.description: true: the columns fit their content, the widths only a start.
